cohort: The study included 2,943,532 women with birth-related admissions in the United States from 2016 to 2019, identified from the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project-National Inpatient Sample.
finding: Adenomyosis in pregnancy is associated with adverse obstetric and fetal outcomes, including increased risks of placenta abruptio, preterm delivery, and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Pregnancies with adenomyosis had an elevated risk of delivering by cesarean (adjusted OR 15.7, 95% CI 12.7-19.3).
